summary: Tested and fixed the D&D RPG Forge campaign generation flow. The original bug was that after pressing 'Generate Campaign', the app would show an error page instead of the adventure screen. Root cause: In RPGGame.jsx session bridge, the `...characterData` spread was overwriting properly extracted string values (like background) with original object values ({key, variantKey}), causing React to fail when rendering objects as children.

bugs_fixed.issue: Session bridge was spreading characterData after setting extracted values, causing object fields (background, race, class) to overwrite string values
bugs_fixed.fix: Moved ...characterData spread to the beginning of the object, so extracted string values override the object fields

critical_code_review_comments: The ability scores in the adventure screen show all 10s instead of the selected values (15, 14, 13, 12, 10, 8). This is a minor data mapping issue in the session bridge - the abilities field uses different keys (STR vs str) than what's stored in the character data.
seed_data_creation: Test characters created during testing with prefix 'TEST_' and 'FixTestHero'
context_for_next_testing_agent: Campaign generation flow is now working end-to-end. Backend APIs (character creation, campaign draft, world generation, knowledge cards) all pass. Frontend flow from Main Menu → Character Creation (7 steps) → Campaign Setup → Generate Campaign → Adventure screen works correctly. Minor issue: ability scores display as default 10s instead of selected values.
